majorVersion.description: Major version is incremented when there are incompatible API changes

minorVersion.description: Minor version is incremented when a functionality is added in a backwards-compatible manner

patchVersion.description: Patch version is incremented when backwards-compatible bug fixes are made

deprecated.description: A flag to represent if current version is supported by the C3 metadata repository store

title: Release version for C3 metadata repository, using the same versioning scheme as Semantic Versioning
name: ReleaseVersion
